Connect Lena to Gemini (once per device)

  1. Open Google AI Studio → API keys and sign in with your Google account.
  2. Tap Create API key and copy it.
  3. Paste it below. It stays only in this browser on this device: it is not in the game file on GitHub and not in your exported progress.

Free keys: Google may use these chats to improve its services, so don't share private details with Lena.

🔊 Lenas Stimme (Lena’s voice, this device only)

Lena spricht mit einer Stimme Ihres Geräts. Wählen Sie die klarste. · Lena uses a voice installed on this device: choose the clearest one.

Tempo · speed:
💡 Die klarste Gerätestimme finden · find the clearest device voice
  • Laptop: open the game in Microsoft Edge and choose a voice marked ⭐ (e.g. Katja Online (Natural), Seraphina, Amala). These are among the clearest free German voices.
  • Android tablet: Settings → Text-to-speech output → Google speech engine → ⚙ → Install voice data → Deutsch (Deutschland); choose the voice that sounds clearest. Then reopen the game and pick it here.
  • Tap ▶ Probe hören after each change.
